items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Native desktop tokens after Synara/Codex: system UI font (-apple-system/Segoe UI) on a 13px type scale (text-ui-2xs/xs/sm/ui/lg = 10/11/12/13/14px), translucent black/white fills for secondary/muted/accent, 5-6% hairline borders, a neutral black/white primary (accent presets: theme-blue, theme-green, theme-orange, theme-rose, theme-violet), a five-hue chart palette (chart-1..5), a 0.625rem radius with multiplier steps (sm .6x, md .8x, xl 1.4x, 2xl 1.8x, shell 1.3x), near-flat elevation shadows (raised, pressed, primary, well, surface, chip), shell/shell-border app-chrome tokens and a shell-inset utility for the rail layout, code surface and scrollbar tokens with thin rounded scrollbars and scrollbar-thin/-hover/-none utilities, reading tokens (max-w-reading 68ch, max-w-page, image outline) and a prose-qy long-form typography utility. Installs @qinyang/utils (cn that knows the text-ui sizes).

theme.font-mono: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, "JetBrains Mono"), "JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

& :where(blockquote):not(:where(.not-pro.box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 70%, transparent), var(--skeuo-well)

items.name: utils
items.title: cn helper
items.description: cn() = clsx + tailwind-merge, extended so the theme's text-ui-2xs … text-ui-lg sizes merge as font sizes (not colours).

items.name: theme-green
items.title: Theme: Green accent
items.description: Green accent preset: swaps the neutral primary, primary-foreground and ring for green in light and dark. Install after @qinyang/theme.

items.name: theme-orange
items.title: Theme: Orange accent
items.description: Orange accent preset: swaps the neutral primary, primary-foreground and ring for orange in light and dark. Install after @qinyang/theme.

items.name: theme-rose
items.title: Theme: Rose accent
items.description: Rose accent preset: swaps the neutral primary, primary-foreground and ring for rose in light and dark. Install after @qinyang/theme.

items.name: theme-violet
items.title: Theme: Violet accent
items.description: Violet accent preset: swaps the neutral primary, primary-foreground and ring for violet in light and dark. Install after @qinyang/theme.

items.name: icons

items.name: icon-chip

items.description: The house frame for title and header icons: a raised squircle in four sizes with neutral, tinted and solid tones, so every card header reads as one icon family.

items.name: saas-dashboard

items.name: agent-workspace
items.title: Agent Workspace

items.name: landing

items.name: docs
items.title: Docs Site

items.name: blog

items.name: accordion

items.name: marquee

items.name: loader

items.name: multi-select

items.name: button-stateful

items.name: magnetic

items.name: hold-action-button
items.title: Hold Action Button

items.name: slide-action-button
items.title: Slide Action Button
items.description: Inset track with a draggable thumb that confirms when slid to the end (with an optional pending state for async work) and springs back otherwise; keyboard-operable as a slider.

items.name: expanding-arrow-button
items.title: Expanding Arrow Button
items.description: Button with an accent tile that sweeps across the button into a fading trail of dotted chevrons on hover or keyboard focus.

items.name: expandable-control
items.title: Expandable Control
items.description: Click-to-expand controls: an icon button that grows to reveal its label and a chip that reveals a trailing action, both morphing width on a spring.

items.name: text-cascade
items.title: Text Cascade
items.description: Standalone text that rolls letter by letter, left to right, through a soft blur whenever its value changes, gliding to the new width.

items.name: action-swap-blur
items.title: Action Swap Blur
items.description: Copy-button style control whose label and icon dissolve into the next state with blur, fade and scale, with optional auto-reset.

items.name: action-swap-roll
items.title: Action Swap Roll
items.description: Button whose next label and icon roll up from below through a soft blur as the old ones lift away.

items.name: digit-swap
items.title: Digit Swap
items.description: Fixed-slot digits and mask glyphs that roll only where they change, with auto/up/down direction and stagger from either end.

items.name: select-morph
items.title: Select Morph

items.name: popover-morph
items.title: Popover Morph

items.name: morphing-modal
items.title: Morphing Modal
items.description: Single dialog surface with inner views that springs to each view's height as you navigate, with direction-aware transitions and back navigation.

items.name: shared-layout-bg
items.title: Shared Layout Background
items.description: Raised hover pill that glides between items via shared layout, follows keyboard focus, and blurs in and out as the pointer enters and leaves the group.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Responsive frame locked to a ratio that springs smoothly between ratios, with a cover-cropped image part that scales without stretching.

items.name: wheel-picker
items.title: Wheel Picker
items.description: iOS-style picker wheel: a 3D drum driven by a real scroll container, so it gets native momentum and scroll-snap detents, plus mouse drag and full keyboard control; compose several in a WheelPickerGroup for times and dates.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: Composable colour picker whose raised trigger chip morphs open into a saturation/brightness area with hue and opacity sliders, a hex field and presets.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: Composable date range picker (Root, Trigger, Content, Calendar, Grid, Presets, Summary, Clear) with animated month navigation, hover range preview and keyboard grid navigation, built on Intl and Date with no date library.

items.name: sortable-stack
items.title: Sortable Stack
items.description: Drag-to-reorder stack of raised rows on motion Reorder, dragged from a grip handle, with keyboard reordering, screen-reader announcements and a one-step undo.

items.name: range-slider-inline
items.title: Range Slider Inline
items.description: Base UI slider with a raised fill growing inside an inset well, the label and value printed on the track, ten stop markers and a slim thumb that parts around the text.

items.name: pull-to-refresh
items.title: Pull to Refresh
items.description: Scroll container with rubber-band pull, a threshold arrow that winds up and turns primary, async onRefresh and our loader while it runs.

items.name: smooth-scroll
items.title: Smooth Scroll
items.description: Lenis-powered SmoothScroll provider that eases the window or its own scroll container, with a useSmoothScroll hook exposing offset, progress, velocity and scrollTo.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: Scroll Progress
items.description: Scroll-driven progress indicator as an edge bar (fixed, sticky or absolute) or a raised ring with an optional percentage, spring-smoothed and exposed as a progressbar.

items.name: scroll-to
items.title: Scroll To
items.description: Button that eases to a px offset, selector or element through the nearest SmoothScroll, falling back to native smooth scrolling, and can move focus to the target.

items.name: scroll-reveal
items.title: Scroll Reveal
items.description: Reveals content with a spring slide and blur as it enters view, from any side, once or every time it re-enters.

items.name: shader-background
items.title: Shader Background
items.description: Animated WebGL background in mesh-gradient, grain, warp, waves and dot-orbit variants, coloured from props or theme tokens and paused offscreen or under reduced motion.

items.name: chart-utils
items.title: Chart Utils
items.description: Shared chart helpers: token-based palette (chart-1..5 with semantic fallbacks), linear/band scales, ResizeObserver sizing, seeded PRNG, formatters, springy ChartNumber, in-chart tooltip shell and raised legend pills.

items.name: animated-sidebar
items.title: Animated Sidebar
items.description: Composable app sidebar (Provider, Sidebar, Header, Content, Group, Item, Sub, Footer, Trigger, Inset) with a gliding active pill that morphs through nested navigation and a spring fold into an icon rail with tooltips.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: Declarative file and folder primitives rendered as an ARIA tree with springing rows and branch guides, a gliding raised selection, and full keyboard navigation with typeahead.

items.name: preview-rail
items.title: Preview Rail
items.description: Navigation rail of compact ticks that swell into a pyramid around the pointed or focused tick while a preview card glides alongside to reveal its label and description.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Virtualized data table for 10k+ rows with click-to-sort headers, checkbox row selection with shift-click ranges, drag-to-resize and drag-to-reorder columns, and rows and columns that glide into new positions.

items.name: table-editable
items.title: Table Editable
items.description: Spreadsheet-style table that edits cells in place, walks the grid with arrow keys, and inserts or deletes rows and columns from border handles and + pills with a smooth re-layout.

items.name: table-async
items.title: Table Async
items.description: Table that loads pages on demand: skeleton rows on first load, infinite scroll as the virtualized list nears its end, a loading footer, retry on failure and an end-of-list note.

items.name: message-bubble
items.title: Message Bubble
items.description: Single conversational bubble with tones, start/end alignment, joined corners when grouped, an expandable long-content section and render-prop support for link or button bubbles.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Composable conversation primitives: Message rows aligned by sender, MessageAvatar, auto-grouped MessageContent bubbles, MessageHeader, MessageMeta, hover-revealed MessageActions, typing indicator and day markers.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: Conversation viewport that glides with streamed output at the live edge, releases as soon as the reader scrolls up, and offers a 'jump to latest' pill that turns into 'New messages' when content arrives below.

items.name: agent-code-block
items.title: Agent Code Block
items.description: Shiki-highlighted code surface for agent output that streams without flicker, with line numbers, highlighted lines, a filename header, a live caret that follows the newest line and a copy button.

items.name: file-diff
items.title: File Diff
items.description: Collapsible unified-diff view of one file change with live +/− counts and a diffstat, syntax-highlighted rows with old/new line numbers, and rows that animate in while an agent streams the edit.

items.name: tool-result
items.title: Tool Result
items.description: Execution disclosure for an agent tool call, with live status, ticking duration, Shiki-highlighted terminal output or request/response, copy and retry, collapsing once it finishes.

items.name: citations
items.title: Citations
items.description: Inline numbered citation markers with a Base UI PreviewCard hover preview, linked through a CitationGroup to a collapsible, progressively animated reference list.

items.name: streaming-response
items.title: Streaming Response
items.description: Stable assistant reply surface that renders streamed markdown-ish text with a caret, then reveals copy, regenerate and thumbs feedback actions plus an expandable sources list.

items.name: image-generation
items.title: Image Generation
items.description: Fixed-frame generated-image surface that moves from queued through a grain and blur refinement reveal to a sharp result with prompt, copy, regenerate and download actions.

items.name: tool-approval
items.title: Tool Approval
items.description: Human-in-the-loop permission card with tool name, risk level and arguments preview, offering Allow once, Always allow or Deny, with a remembered, revocable state.

items.name: agent-activity
items.title: Agent Activity
items.description: One adaptive activity stream for an agent run that groups reasoning, web searches, tool calls and steps on a timeline, with live shimmering status and collapsing groups.

items.name: reasoning-text
items.title: Reasoning Text
items.description: Shimmering reasoning copy with a terminal ASCII spinner that cycles phrases by blur swap, letter cascade or scramble.

items.name: agent-progress
items.title: Agent Progress
items.description: Compact working readout: a pulsing 3×3 activity glyph, an action verb and a live tabular timer that can pause, resume or be controlled.

items.name: todo-list
items.title: Todo List
items.description: Collapsible agent task plan with morphing pending, in-progress, done and failed marks, a rolling completion count and compact per-step meta.

items.name: ai-sidebar
items.title: AI Sidebar
items.description: Collapsible AI workspace sidebar with folders, projects, files and bookmarks, an icon rail, ⌘K search with highlighted matches, tree keyboard navigation and inline rename.

items.name: treemap
items.title: Treemap
items.description: Squarified treemap in plain SVG with one level of grouping, tiles that spring to new positions when data changes, value/share tooltips and a group-highlighting legend.

items.name: candlestick-chart
items.title: Candlestick Chart
items.description: OHLC candles with a volume pane, animated last-price line and a crosshair with price/time readouts, keyboard inspectable and built for live-updating data.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut Chart
items.description: Ring of rounded, gapped segments in an inset track with a centre readout and legend that highlight together on hover or focus.

items.name: status-bar
items.title: Status Bar
items.description: Uptime-style status history of rounded bars with a live status header, uptime percentage, period tooltips and a counted legend.

items.name: composition-chart
items.title: Composition Chart
items.description: Normalised 100% composition over periods as stacked bars or morphing smooth areas, with period tooltips and a legend that toggles and highlights series.

items.name: funnel-chart
items.title: Funnel Chart
items.description: Vertical or horizontal funnel of S-curved stages that morph with the data, with conversion labels and animated-number tooltips for value, share and drop-off.

items.name: heat-calendar
items.title: Heat Calendar
items.description: GitHub-style activity calendar on UTC dates with composable Grid, Tooltip, Summary and Legend parts, single-hue intensity levels, and controlled drag/keyboard range selection that totals the span.

items.name: returns-calendar
items.title: Returns Calendar
items.description: Monthly returns calendar with a years × months grid (diverging tints, compounded year totals) or a year-cards view with mini monthly bars, tooltips (best/worst, YTD) and controlled month-range or whole-year selection with compounded totals.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: Light/dark button that repaints the page through the View Transition API with a circular reveal from the click point, falling back to an instant swap.

items.name: recommendation-card
items.title: Recommendation Card

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal with a soft scale-in, dimmed backdrop and close button.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Dropdown menu with a soft highlight, checkbox and radio items, submenus and shortcuts.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip with scale-in motion and an optional keyboard hint.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Select that aligns the chosen item with the trigger, with groups and check indicator.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Stacked, swipeable toasts with typed icons, actions and promise-style updates.

items.name: prompt-bar
items.title: Prompt Bar
items.description: Auto-growing prompt input with attach, voice, and an animated send/stop button.

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: Chat thread with spring-in bubbles and a typing indicator.

items.name: approval-card
items.title: Approval Card
items.description: Approve or decline an agent action, with animated result and undo.

items.name: task-row
items.title: Task Row
items.description: Background task row with animated status marks (queued, running, done, failed).

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: One-time-code field on Base UI OTPField with a gliding focus ring, digits that roll in, paste and autofill support, an error shake and a success check.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: ⌘K palette with fuzzy search, grouped results, a gliding active row, keyboard navigation and shortcut hints.

items.name: chat-app
items.title: Chat App
items.description: A complete agent workspace: AI sidebar, a conversation where each turn reasons, runs a live plan and streams its reply, and a prompt bar with stop, driven by a scripted fake agent.

items.name: notification-stack
items.title: Notification Stack
items.description: Compact notification cards stacked into a peeking summary that spring apart into a readable, dismissible list on hover, focus or tap.

items.name: feedback-widget
items.title: Feedback Widget
items.description: Corner trigger that morphs into a feedback popup with message and mood picker, then animates through sending, success and retry states.

items.name: expandable-action-bar
items.title: Expandable Action Bar
items.description: Toolbar of compact icon actions that expand into labelled controls on hover or keyboard focus, with a gliding active highlight, badges and shortcut hints.

items.name: overflow-actions
items.title: Overflow Actions
items.description: Connected pill rail of primary actions whose toggle springs the rail open to reveal extra controls, with staggered blur-in and an Escape to fold.

items.name: morphing-search
items.title: Morphing Search
items.description: A search field or compact icon that morphs into a results surface with grouped, highlighted matches, full keyboard navigation and an opt-in ⌘/Ctrl shortcut.

items.name: expandable-tabs
items.title: Expandable Tabs
items.description: Icon tab bar whose active tab expands into a labelled pill while the panel above morphs its height and slides content in from the direction you moved.

items.name: morphing-tabs
items.title: Morphing Tabs
items.description: Drag- or keyboard-reorderable tabs whose selected tab joins a content surface that glides between tabs and morphs to each panel's height.

items.name: swipeable-list
items.title: Swipeable List
items.description: Mobile-style rows that swipe left or right to reveal tinted action rails, commit the edge action on a full swipe, and open from the keyboard with the arrow keys.

items.name: project-folder
items.title: Project Folder
items.description: A folder whose file sheets fan out on hover or keyboard focus and fly into a focus-managed folder view dialog, then retrace their path when it closes.

items.name: card-folder
items.title: Card Folder
items.description: A landscape payment card tucked into a stitched pocket that compresses into its seam as the card lifts forward, with a blur-swap details reveal, copy and overflow actions.

items.name: attachment-upload
items.title: Attachment Upload
items.description: Mixed attachment workspace with a collapsing dropzone, staggered file, image and link rows, animated upload progress, retry, removal and shared-layout image previews.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: Drag-and-drop upload queue with springy progress rows, queued/uploading/uploaded/failed states, retry and removal, driven by a pluggable upload function.

items.name: availability-scheduler
items.title: Availability Scheduler
items.description: Weekly availability editor where each day springs between available and unavailable, time ranges slide in and out as you add or remove them, times pick from a scrollable select, overlaps are flagged and a copy menu clones a day's hours to all days, weekdays or chosen days.

items.name: signup-form
items.title: Sign-up Form
items.description: Composed sign-up form that flags a field once it is left, clears the error the moment it is fixed, shows a length-weighted password strength meter with a reveal toggle, accepts server field errors and walks the submit button through loading, success and error.

items.name: not-found-terminal
items.title: 404 Terminal
items.description: 404 page as a terminal session that types a failed cd into the missing path, prints the 404 status and idles on a blinking caret.
